awards.title: McKelvy Scholar
awards.summary: Being a McKelvy Scholar is a unique opportunity and honor. Scholars foster a community built around high-level academic work, broad leadership on campus and in the community, intellectual curiosity, creative expression, inclusive values, and a culture of self-reflective inquiry.

awards.title: Alpha Alpha Alpha: First-Generation Honors Society
awards.summary: A national honor society specifically for first-generation college students. It recognizes and celebrates the academic achievements of students who are the first in their families to earn a bachelor's degree.

awards.title: Posse Foundation Full Tuition Leadership Scholarship
awards.summary: Identified for their leadership ability and overall motivation to succeed, Posse Scholars head campus organizations, encourage dialogue and programs that foster an inclusive campus environment, and achieve academic success.

awards.title: The George Wharton Pepper Prize Finalist
awards.summary: The George Wharton Pepper Prize, awarded annually to the senior “who most nearly represents the Lafayette ideal,” through leadership and academics.

awards.title: Benjamin F. Barge Oratorical Prize
awards.summary: Presented to a member of the senior class who writes and pronounces in public competition an English oration in the best manner

awards.title: Speech & Debate State Champion
awards.summary: Selected as the best speaker among competitors from all schools in the State of Pennsylvania for various events.

awards.title: Academic Research Committee Student Research Expense Award
Irene Ryan Acting Scholarship Nominee
awards.summary: The Irene Ryan Acting Scholarships provide recognition, honor, and financial assistance to outstanding student performers wishing to pursue further education.

publications.name: Social Comparisons of Prejudice Within Greek Life
publications.summary: This study explored how members of Greek life compare themselves to others regarding prejudice, analyzing qualitative and quantitative data submitted by student participants.

publications.name: Social Comparisons of Prejudice Among Greek Life Students
publications.publisher: Society for Personality and Social Psychology Annual Convention
publications.summary: This poster presented findings on the role of social comparison in shaping attitudes about prejudice within Greek life communities.

publications.name: I Go, Therefore I Belong: Examining the Role of Social Identity on Campus Space Use and Student Belonging
publications.publisher: Lafayette College Student Research Poster Session
publications.summary: This project examined how student identity affects campus navigation and perceptions of belonging based on space usage patterns.

publications.name: Using Targeted Memory Reactivation to Determine Preferential Consolidation of Unique vs Shared Information
publications.publisher: Summer Undergraduate Internship Program Conference, University of Pennsylvania
publications.summary: Research focused on the use of memory reactivation techniques during sleep to assess whether unique or shared information is better consolidated.
